title: Impure public good

definition.text: A good that is non-rival and non-excludable only partly or only some of the time.

facts.text: Some parts of cybersecurity, such as sharing threat information and protecting critical infrastructure and election integrity, behave like impure public goods.
Public property is sometimes treated as a public good, usually an impure one.
Since pure public goods are rare, most goods called public are impure in practice.

notes: Phrase concept with no page. S:08a4186c998e also equates open-access property with 'impure public good', a usage inconsistent with the Public good page; not used.
